file_name: 2026 - Revisiting Risky Tackle Detection with Vision Transformers - Zaidi et al.pdf
universal_lens: Vision transformers with focal loss and Taguchi L18 augmentation enable reproducible risky tackle detection via 5-fold cross-validation. Vision transformers process spatiotemporal video clips via tokenized patches; risk detection relies on geometric change cues and temporal alignment of FPOC.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian risk assessment models integrate ViViT predictions with SATT-3 rubric labels using conformal prediction intervals for uncertain classifications. Bayesian inference models tackle risk using probabilistic classification over augmented video features, conditioned on FPOC localization and geometric stability.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine maps FPOC localization and frame-level actions into state transitions for real-time tackle risk scoring during practice videos. Situational reasoning maps athlete kinematics through state transitions defined by FPOC timing and visual augmentation regimes, enabling dynamic risk prediction.
